title: AgentCARD FinanceBench confirmatory disjoint prompt-scaffold holdout

relationship_to_prior_evidence.holdout_selection: next 60 tasks in the same deterministic stratified order after skipping the prior 30
relationship_to_prior_evidence.reason: increase paired evidence without changing prompts or selecting tasks from outcomes

analysis.primary: Within the independent N=60 holdout, compare gpt-5.4 planner minus gpt-5.4 executor for each scaffold using accuracy, paired transitions, 10000-draw paired bootstrap interval, and exact two-sided McNemar test.
secondary: Within each model direction, compare LangChain minus submitted scaffold on the N=60 holdout.
Concatenate the disjoint valid N=30 and holdout N=60 per-task records and report the same paired analyses at N=90.
analysis.failure_policy: Task/model/tool failures score zero. All 60 task IDs remain in every arm.
analysis.infrastructure_policy: Any HTTP 5xx, auth_unavailable, or connection-timeout task error invalidates the entire four-arm holdout matrix. Do not selectively rerun tasks. One complete four-arm restart after a passing endpoint health gate is allowed and must be recorded.
analysis.reporting: Report all four holdout arms, both scaffold direction contrasts, both prompt effects, and the N=90 secondary analysis regardless of direction. Preserve any infrastructure-invalid attempt.
